target: Necessary/sufficient Rouquier-parity conditions and parity-producing/preserving braid operations.
hypotheses: Coefficient field C; raw Hogancamp–Mellit positive Rouquier/Hochschild-cohomology convention.
s=σ1, r=σ2 in B3; gamma=r s r² s² r² and gamma_k=gamma s^(2k), k≥0.
The all-power operation is the proper FT2=s², not central FT3=(sr)³.
accepted_conclusions: HHH(gamma) is even in Rouquier degree.
For every integer k≥1, ordinary unreduced HHH(gamma_k) has both Rouquier parities.
All ordinary unreduced Euler series in this family are coefficientwise nonnegative in q at zero.
A single-step parity-preservation counterexample holds for the reflected and conventional positive Jucys–Murphy braid.
remaining_gap: The full parity characterization and central-full-twist preservation/eventual parity questions remain unresolved by this work. No algebraic-link or pure nested-full-twist conjecture is refuted.
